# route submodule

This submodule deploys a route as a child resource of a route table.

**Breaking changes:** the source suffix is now `//modules/route-table-route` instead of `//modules/route-table/modules/route`. Direct callers must also supply `location`, including when `enable_telemetry = false`; choose a region available in your Azure cloud for the telemetry deployment.

## Usage

The `route-table` module calls this submodule using `for_each`. It can also be consumed directly:

```terraform
module "route" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-ptn-alz-sub-vending/azure//modules/route-table-route"
  version = "<version>"

  address_prefix = "10.0.0.0/8"
  location       = var.location
  name           = "private-network"
  next_hop_type  = "VnetLocal"
  parent_id      = "/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/example/providers/Microsoft.Network/routeTables/example"
}
```

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_address_prefix"></a> [address\_prefix](#input\_address\_prefix)

Description: (Required) The destination CIDR to which the route applies.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: The Azure region for this module's resources or telemetry deployment.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: (Required) The name of the route.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_next_hop_type"></a> [next\_hop\_type](#input\_next\_hop\_type)

Description: (Required) The type of Azure hop the packet should be sent to. Possible values are `VirtualNetworkGateway`, `VnetLocal`, `Internet`, `VirtualAppliance` and `None`.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: The fully-qualified ARM resource ID of the route table into which this route will be deployed.

Type: `string`
